title: A Escarpment for the Provision
author: Juniper Dravenmoor
blurb: Rafael Okonkwo, a railroad engineer with a map of closed lines, has spent three years measuring life in miles rather than years. But when an old rival hires the crew for the one job that was sworn off long ago, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must cross the range ahead of the snows before the monsoon makes landfall.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
